cases.title: Invoice paid in part, then in full
cases.description: Create and post an invoice, apply a partial payment and check the balance, then apply the remainder.
cases.expectedResult: The balance falls after each payment, and the invoice shows as paid in the customer account and the receipts register.

cases.title: Credit note against an invoice
cases.description: Issue a credit note for part of a posted invoice and apply it.
cases.expectedResult: The invoice balance falls by the credit, and the revenue and tax postings reverse in proportion.

cases.title: Tax and rounding on a multi-line invoice
cases.description: Enter an invoice with many small lines, a mix of taxable and exempt items, and a discount. Compare line-level and invoice-level tax.
cases.expectedResult: Tax follows the documented rounding rule, and the total equals the sum of its parts to the cent.

cases.title: Pricing: discounts and markups
cases.description: Apply a percentage discount, then a fixed discount, then a customer price list or markup, to an invoice.
cases.expectedResult: Each adjustment calculates correctly on its own and in combination, and the invoice shows what was applied.

cases.title: Recurring invoice run
cases.description: Set up a recurring invoice (monthly, with one price change), run it for three periods, and review the results.
cases.expectedResult: One invoice is created per period, with the right dates and amounts, and a rerun creates no duplicates.

cases.title: Customer statement and aging agree with open invoices
cases.description: Run the customer statement and the aging report, and compare them with the list of open invoices.
cases.expectedResult: Both show the same open items, and every item sits in the right aging bucket.

cases.title: Duplicate invoice number is refused
cases.description: Enter a second invoice with the number of one already posted.
cases.expectedResult: The system refuses it or warns clearly, and no duplicate is posted.

cases.title: Milestone or progress billing
cases.description: Bill a contract in stages: a deposit, a percentage of completion, and a final invoice.
cases.expectedResult: Amounts billed to date never exceed the contract value, and each stage is posted to the right period.

cases.title: Invoice delivery by email
cases.description: Email two invoices, one to a separate billing contact, and check the invoice register.
cases.expectedResult: The right address receives each invoice, and the register shows both as sent.

cases.title: Overpayment and unapplied cash
cases.description: Receive a payment larger than the invoice, then one with no invoice to match.
cases.expectedResult: The excess is held as unapplied credit, can be applied later, and the customer balance is correct.

cases.title: Bad debt write-off
cases.description: Write off an uncollectable invoice, then receive a late payment for it.
cases.expectedResult: The write-off posts to the expense account, and the late payment reverses it correctly.

cases.title: Foreign currency invoice paid at a different rate
cases.description: Issue an invoice in a foreign currency and receive payment after the exchange rate has changed.
cases.expectedResult: The exchange gain or loss is posted, and the customer balance clears to zero in both currencies.

cases.title: Three-way match mismatch is flagged
cases.description: Receive part of an order, then enter a bill for a different quantity or price.
cases.expectedResult: The mismatch is flagged before payment, and the approver sees the difference.

cases.title: Bill batch with and without an order, including a split allocation
cases.description: Enter a batch of bills: some matched to an order, some not, and one split across several accounts.
cases.expectedResult: Each bill posts with the right allocation, and the batch review lists them correctly.

cases.title: Payment run selected by due date and supplier
cases.description: Build a payment run by due date, for one supplier and for all suppliers, and select bills from several suppliers.
cases.expectedResult: Totals follow the selection, and only bills that are due and approved are offered.

cases.title: Print, cancel and reinstate a payment
cases.description: Print payments for a set of bills, cancel one, and reinstate it.
cases.expectedResult: The payment register is correct after each step, the bill reopens on cancel, and the audit shows both actions.

cases.title: Duplicate payment is prevented
cases.description: Select the same bill twice in one payment, then try to pay a bill that was already paid.
cases.expectedResult: A clear warning blocks both, and each bill is paid once.

cases.title: Create purchase orders with each line type
cases.description: Create orders with a stocked item, a non-stocked item, a service, and a comment line.
cases.expectedResult: All lines save correctly, and the order total is right.

cases.title: Receive an order in full and in part
cases.description: Receive one order fully and another partially.
cases.expectedResult: Quantities received and outstanding are right, and the order status follows.

cases.title: Revise, cancel and close an order
cases.description: Revise a released order, cancel another, and close a third with a quantity still open.
cases.expectedResult: The revision history is kept, cancelled orders cannot be received, and closing releases the open commitment.

cases.title: Correct the number of a posted bill
cases.description: Change the reference number of a posted bill and add a note.
cases.expectedResult: The new number shows everywhere, the note is kept, and the audit log records who changed it.

cases.title: Early payment discount and late fee
cases.description: Pay one bill inside its discount window and another after its due date.
cases.expectedResult: The discount or fee is calculated by the terms on the bill and posted to the right accounts.

cases.title: Post a balanced ledger entry
cases.description: Post a balanced entry with a note attached and look it up in the ledger inquiry.
cases.expectedResult: The entry appears with the right accounts, amounts, period and note.

cases.title: Reject an unbalanced ledger entry
cases.description: Try to post an entry where debits and credits differ by one cent.
cases.expectedResult: The entry is refused with a clear message and nothing is posted.

cases.title: Trial balance agrees with the account and history inquiries
cases.description: Run the account inquiry and the history inquiry for one period and compare them with the trial balance.
cases.expectedResult: Balances in all three agree for every account checked.

cases.title: Posting into a closed period is refused
cases.description: Try to post an entry dated in a closed period.
cases.expectedResult: The posting is refused, or needs an authorised override that is recorded in the audit log.

cases.title: Close and reopen a period
cases.description: Close a period, confirm postings are blocked, reopen it with authority, post a correction, and close it again.
cases.expectedResult: Closing blocks postings, reopening is logged, and the correction lands in the right period.

cases.title: Bank reconciliation
cases.description: Import a bank statement, match it with ledger entries, and leave a few items unmatched.
cases.expectedResult: Matched items clear, unmatched items stay listed, and the reconciled balance equals the statement balance.

cases.title: Financial statements balance
cases.description: Produce the balance sheet and income statement for a period, and compare them with the trial balance.
cases.expectedResult: Assets equal liabilities plus equity, and net income ties to the retained earnings movement.

cases.title: Sub-ledgers reconcile to the ledger
cases.description: Run receivables aging, payables aging and the inventory valuation, and compare each with its control account at the period end date.
cases.expectedResult: Each sub-ledger total equals its control account.

cases.title: Recurring and reversing ledger entries
cases.description: Create a monthly recurring entry and an accrual that reverses on the first day of the next period.
cases.expectedResult: Each entry posts in the right period, and the reversal cancels the original exactly.

cases.title: Currency revaluation at period end
cases.description: Hold foreign currency balances at period end and run the revaluation.
cases.expectedResult: Unrealised gains and losses post once, with a reversal on the first day of the next period.

cases.title: Stock valuation agrees with the ledger
cases.description: Run the valuation report and the transaction log, then compare their totals with the inventory account.
cases.expectedResult: The valuation, the log and the account agree in total.

cases.title: Costing method changes cost correctly
cases.description: Receive the same item at three different prices, then sell part of it under average cost, then under first-in first-out.
cases.expectedResult: Cost of sales and remaining stock value follow each method exactly.

cases.title: Stock count cycle
cases.description: Take a count snapshot, enter counts for each location, and post the differences.
cases.expectedResult: Counts are recorded against the snapshot, and the variance posts once to stock and the ledger.

cases.title: Receipts and adjustments change quantity on hand
cases.description: Receive stock, then make a positive and a negative adjustment.
cases.expectedResult: Quantity and value move by the expected amounts, and stock cannot go below zero unless the setting allows it.

cases.title: Counter sale and return
cases.description: Sell items over the counter, reverse one sale, and return part of another.
cases.expectedResult: Stock, sales and tax update on sale and return to their starting values on reversal.

cases.title: Acquire an asset and run depreciation
cases.description: Add an asset with a cost, useful life and method, and run depreciation for three periods.
cases.expectedResult: Depreciation posts each period by the chosen method, and the book value falls by the same amounts.

cases.title: Dispose of an asset
cases.description: Sell an asset part-way through its life and record the proceeds.
cases.expectedResult: The gain or loss is posted, depreciation stops, and the asset leaves the register.

cases.title: Gross to net calculation
cases.description: Enter hours for four employees, including overtime, and calculate taxes and deductions.
cases.expectedResult: Net pay equals gross pay less deductions for each employee, with no rounding drift.

cases.title: Pay register agrees with the ledger after the update
cases.description: Print the pay register, compare it with the pay record inquiry, then run the payroll update and check the ledger.
cases.expectedResult: The register, the records and the ledger postings show the same figures.

cases.title: Payment output for each pay method
cases.description: Print cheques, create the direct deposit file and email the earnings statements.
cases.expectedResult: Amounts, names and bank details are correct on every output.

cases.title: Employee and pay period setup
cases.description: Create a pay period and two employees, one paid by cheque and one by direct deposit with an emailed earnings statement.
cases.expectedResult: Both employees save with the right payment method and bank or email details.

cases.title: Tax rate change takes effect on the right date
cases.description: Add a new tax rate with a future start date, then enter invoices dated before and after it.
cases.expectedResult: Invoices before the date use the old rate, and invoices on or after it use the new one.

cases.title: Tax return totals agree with the ledger
cases.description: Run the tax return for a period and compare each box with the ledger tax accounts.
cases.expectedResult: Tax collected, tax paid and the balance due agree with the ledger.

cases.title: Role-based access
cases.description: Sign in as a user without permission and try to view, post, approve and export in each area.
cases.expectedResult: Each action is limited as configured, and refused actions are logged.

cases.title: Creator cannot approve their own transaction
cases.description: Create a bill, a payment and a ledger entry, then try to approve each with the same user.
cases.expectedResult: Self-approval is blocked, and a second user can approve.

cases.title: Approval limits route to the right approver
cases.description: Submit transactions just below, at and just above an approval limit.
cases.expectedResult: Each goes to the approver for its amount, and none skips a level.

cases.title: Audit trail records every change
cases.description: Edit, delete and reverse records in several areas, then read the audit log.
cases.expectedResult: Each entry shows who, when, what changed, and the values before and after.

cases.title: Attach supporting documents to a record
cases.description: Attach an image and a PDF at the same time to a customer, supplier or transaction, then find them by date and filter.
cases.expectedResult: Both files are saved and can be opened from the record and from the document list.

cases.title: Invoice PDF includes chosen attachments
cases.description: Choose attachments to merge into an invoice, produce the PDF, and open it.
cases.expectedResult: The PDF contains the invoice followed by the chosen documents in order.

cases.title: Export and import round trip
cases.description: Export invoices to CSV and import the file into an empty test company.
cases.expectedResult: Totals, taxes and customer links match, and bad rows are reported rather than skipped silently.
